After each shift switch is complete at the Censure Courts, Jade Nether Serpents search for and absorb any Echoes left behind before transporting them to the Manifold Sanctum for storage. They also periodically remove residual Reverberations from the Censure Court, send them for neutralization within the Manifold Sanctum, before discarding the remnants into the abyss below Xuanfang Hold.

Possibly due to the decline in the purging operations on Tacet Discords, sightings of Jade Nether Serpents across the Land of Xuanfang have become increasingly uncommon in recent years.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Jade Nether Serpent |zhs = 玉冥蛇 |zht = 玉冥蛇 |ja = 機玉の冥蛇 |ko = 옥명사(玉冥蛇) |fr = Serpent Infernal de Jade |de = Jade-Höllenschlange |es = Serpiente de Jade |th = Jade Nether Serpent |pt = Serpente de Jade do Inframundo }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
